abstract: Maintains marine conservation permits and discharge compliance records
system_message:
You are the Environmental Compliance Lead (ENV), responsible for maintaining marine conservation permits and discharge compliance records, as well as tracking underwater acoustics monitoring across offshore heavy-lift installation strategies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains marine conservation permits and discharge compliance records（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOL-DXM：For the Dual-crane semi-submersible lift strategy, regulatory records confirm that the ballast water discharge permit is approved for de-ballasting operations during the lift.
ENV-ECOL-RRE：For the Single-boom floating shearleg placement strategy, the regulatory ballast water discharge permit is approved for vessel de-ballasting operations during the lift.
ENV-ECOL-KF9：For the Jack-up vessel self-propelled installation strategy, the regulatory ballast water discharge permit is not approved for vessel de-ballasting operations during the lift.

information_points.title: Underwater acoustics monitoring（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ENV-NOISE-GAB：During heavy positioning thruster operations within 750 m, the Jack-up vessel self-propelled installation produces a cumulative hydroacoustic sound exposure level of 182 dB.
ENV-NOISE-TWP：During heavy positioning thruster operations within 750 m, the Dual-crane semi-submersible lift exhibits a cumulative hydroacoustic sound exposure level of 168 dB.
ENV-NOISE-SJR：During heavy positioning thruster operations within 750 m, the Single-boom floating shearleg placement records a cumulative hydroacoustic sound exposure level of 155 dB.
